name: BOUQuET Dev — Multicentric (curated pairs)
description: BOUQuET (Meta FAIR) is a newly hand-crafted, multicentric translation benchmark — NOT FLORES-derived — making it the project's top low-contamination pick (dev = 504 sentences, test = 854). The official curated evaluation pairs live in benchmark_data/sentence_level/{dev,test}/{src}-{tgt}.parquet (~1000 pairs across 259 languages). QUARANTINED: facebook/bouquet is GATED on HuggingFace (accept-terms + token) AND ships parquet-only (the adapter needs the optional pyarrow dependency), so it cannot be accessed or sha-verified in this environment. The fetch adapter, builder wiring, and card shape are all in place; this card carries a representative stub of curated pairs. MAINTAINER FOLLOW-UP: grant HF access + accept terms, then expand explicitPairs to the full curated set (the public file listing enumerates them) and confirm the parquet column schema in bouquet_adapter._resolve_columns(). Domain 'mixed': hand-crafted multicentric set spanning many domains; domainDistribution is an approximate documented estimate (quarantined, so it never ranks).
quarantineReason: Gated on HuggingFace (facebook/bouquet requires accepting terms + an HF token) and parquet-only (needs optional pyarrow). Cannot be accessed or sha/schema-verified here. Catalogue-only until project grants access and the parquet column schema is confirmed.
